Buyer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at Supplier's option, repair, replacement, or refund of the purchase price for the nonconforming goods, provided that Buyer notifies Supplier in writing within 21 days of discovering the defect. Supplier shall bear the cost of shipping any repaired or replacement goods to Buyer, and Buyer shall grant Supplier reasonable access to inspect the nonconforming goods prior to any repair, replacement, or refund. This warranty is in lieu of all other warranties, express or implied, including any implied warranty of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose, except as expressly set out in this Clause.

Prices for the precision-machined aluminum housings are as set out in Schedule 1 and are denominated in USD unless otherwise agreed in writing. Supplier shall invoice Buyer upon shipment, and payment shall be due forty-five (45) days from the date of each invoice. Should Buyer fail to make payment when due, Supplier may, upon 5 days' prior written notice, suspend further deliveries until all outstanding amounts, together with accrued interest, have been paid in full, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to Supplier. Any change in prices shall require not less than 5 days' prior written notice to Buyer and shall apply only to purchase orders placed after the effective date of the change. All invoices shall be issued in USD and shall separately state the applicable purchase order number, quantity delivered, and unit price for each line item.

This obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of ninety (90) days and shall not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the receiving party. Supplier shall, upon Buyer's reasonable written request, provide documentation evidencing such compliance, and shall permit Buyer or its designated auditor to conduct an on-site compliance audit upon not less than 14 days' prior written notice, no more than once per sixty (60) days period absent reasonable cause. This Agreement shall terminate automatically, without notice, in the event either party becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or becomes subject to proceedings under applicable insolvency law that are not dismissed within 60 days. Upon termination for any reason, Buyer shall pay Supplier for all precision-machined aluminum housings delivered and accepted prior to the effective date of termination, and each party shall, within ninety (90) days, return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party then in its possession.
